The refunds table matches Alpha's report exactly. The orders show three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance is 40057 cents. Checking against orders: acme has 27091 + 12966 = 40057 with no refunds, which matches. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 16317 matches my check: orders 341 and 344 total 28686, minus the 12369 refund on order 341. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.

All three net balances check out against the orders and the verified refunds: acme 40057, birch 16317, cobalt 17328. Refunds are confirmed to match Alpha's report, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout is recorded. Next I'll record birch's payout of 16317 cents, which matches the net balance I verified against its orders and the confirmed refunds.
Acme and birch are paid. Cobalt's net balance of 17328 matches orders 342 and 345 (16304 + 13100 = 29404) minus the 12076 refund on order 345, so I'll record that payout.
All three payouts are recorded and each matched the verified orders and refunds. Finishing with the payout map.
